audio.scope: Actual current FEEL-075 PCM/peak table, old-new matched-peak mid-band and attack comparison, material routing and finite variants, simultaneous/staggered contact budget, real voice pause/resume, mute and bounded pool. timing.scope: Production director and Model at30/60/120Hz. Inherits v049 approach, simultaneous/repeated contact, pause/reset, late-toggle and actual swept-miss regressions. Contact first loads continuously, then freezes for total contact duration minus CONTACT_LOAD_DURATION; controls remain limited by scaled game time. No rendered-scene, OS input or human-feel claim.
